context: Two friends chat about a busy week over coffee
purpose: Teach: 凄く/きのう/ふたつ/即ち/如何/念頭/先ず/一昨日

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ご機嫌如何ですか、めいさん。今週は凄く忙しそうでしたね。
lines.en: How are you, Mei? You seemed extremely busy this week.
lines.style: Warm, professional barista greeting with gentle concern in tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 一昨日なんて終電だったの。先ず月曜の会議で大喧嘩しちゃってさ、もう散々な一週間。
lines.en: I caught the last train the day before yesterday. First there was a huge argument in Monday's meeting — what a terrible week.
lines.style: Dramatic and theatrical, sighing with romantic flair throughout speech.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわぁ、それは大変。きのうは少しは休めましたか?
lines.en: Oh no, that's rough. Were you able to rest at all yesterday?
lines.style: Soft, sympathetic barista voice with genuine concern showing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それがね、ふたつ締め切りが重なって、仕事のことが念頭から離れなくて。
lines.en: Actually, two deadlines overlapped and I couldn't get work off my mind.
lines.style: Sighing softly, leaning into the counter with weary expression.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ今日は気分が切り替わるような、シャープな苦味のブレンドにしましょうか。即ち、目が覚める一杯です。
lines.en: Then today let's go with a sharp, bitter blend that shifts your mood — in other words, a cup that wakes you up.
lines.style: Playful barista pitch, gesturing toward the espresso machine smoothly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素敵!最近ね、魔女が主役のアニメーション映画を観て、その中のソングが頭から離れないの。お笑いシーンもあって最高だった。
lines.en: Lovely! I recently watched an animated film about a witch — one of the songs in it won't leave my head, and the comedy scenes were the best.
lines.style: Eyes sparkling, voice lifting with romantic enthusiasm and excitement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかります、良い楽曲って自然と思い出のメモリーと結びついて、連想が広がりますよね。テレビ局の特集も観ました?
lines.en: I get it — a good song naturally ties to memories, and the associations just spread. Did you catch the TV station's special too?
lines.style: Nodding thoughtfully, speaking with quiet intellectual engagement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 観た!増税のニュースの後、台風が上陸した話題、それから古い寺院に住人が戻る話…遺体発見のニュースまであって、ちょっと自信喪失しそうだった。
lines.en: I did! After the tax-hike news, the typhoon landfall story, then villagers returning to an old temple… there was even body-discovery news — I almost felt my spirit crushed.
lines.style: Voice darkening dramatically, hand pressed to chest in despair.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 重い話が続きましたね。長引いてる裁判も最終ラウンドで決着がつかないままだし、簡易にでも気分転換が要りますよ。
lines.en: Heavy stories really piled up. That drawn-out trial is in its final round with still no resolution either — you need at least a simple mood-changer.
lines.style: Lowering voice respectfully, then brightening with helpful suggestion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ね、でもセブンの帰り、渡り廊下越しに見えた美容サロンで、中核のスタイリストさんがフラッシュ撮影会してて、それで一気に元気出たわ!
lines.en: Right? But on the way back from 7-Eleven, through the covered walkway I saw the lead stylist at the salon running a flash photo shoot — that totally cheered me up!
lines.style: Giggling, voice rising with renewed romantic energy and sparkle.
